현재가 $1035.84는 SMA20 $1035.57과 거의 일치하며 볼린저밴드 중단에 위치. 5일 전 RSI 63.5에서 현재 51.2로 하락했으나 여전히 중립권. MACD 히스토그램은 5일 전 5.8018에서 현재 -3.8062로 악화. 주봉 ADX 39.2는 뚜렷한 추세지만 일봉 ADX 13.1은 무추세 구간으로 충격성 변동 가능성 상존. 5일 연속 관망 판정 유지.
analysis.reasonEn:
RSI is hovering around the 50 level, showing a lack of direction. MACD histogram has turned negative and is worsening. Maintaining a wait-and-see stance for 5 consecutive days. ADX at 13.1 indicates a non-trending phase with potential for shock-like volatility. 

Current price $1035.84 is almost aligned with SMA20 at $1035.57 and sits near the Bollinger Band's middle line. RSI has fallen from 63.5 five days ago to 51.2 today, still within neutral territory. MACD histogram has deteriorated from 5.8018 five days ago to -3.8062 currently. Weekly ADX at 39.2 shows a clear trend, but the daily ADX at 13.1 suggests a non-trending market, leaving room for volatile swings. The wait-and-see stance is maintained for the fifth consecutive day.
